limitations: Rat-only bundled reference lane in this release.
Uses mouse PhosR kinase-substrate and motif objects with a rat L6 phosphoproteome lane, matching the generation script; this is scientific provenance, not a new organism-support claim.
This bundle is approved only as the exact PhosPy-packaged rat l6_native snapshot derived from PhosR 1.20.0 package data.
This approval basis must not be generalized to arbitrary PhosR, PhosphoSitePlus, PRIDE, Kinase Library, or future reference bundles.
Kinase-substrate coverage is incomplete, and motif scoring and contextual scoring are not equivalent.
